environmentVariables.name: DROPSUITE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Set the DROPSUITE_ACCESS_TOKEN credential for the Dropsuite (NinjaOne) MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: DROPSUITE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Your Dropsuite region's host (for example dropsuite.us), used as https://<host>/api.

environmentVariables.name: DROPSUITE_RESELLER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Set the DROPSUITE_RESELLER_TOKEN credential for the Dropsuite (NinjaOne) MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: DROPSUITE_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

environmentVariables.name: DROPSUITE_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: DROPSUITE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The whole API base URL, such as https://dropsuite.us/api. Leave blank to build it from the region host above.

environmentVariables.name: DROPSUITE_ORG
environmentVariables.description: Optional. An organization id or owner email that points the per-organization tools at one client; the server resolves that organization's token from the organization list. Leave blank to name it on each call.

environmentVariables.name: DROPSUITE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Dropsuite requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: DROPSUITE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required by `dropsuite-mcp --transport http`; unused by the default stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
